name: proteomics-mcp
description: Spectrum-level proteomics scoring tools exposed through MCP
long_description: Inspect proteomics identification results and MS2 spectra on your computer. Supports InstaNovo, Casanovo, MaxQuant, FragPipe, Proteome Discoverer, and mapped tables; optional public services provide USI retrieval and Koina predictions.

output_dir.title: Default output directory
output_dir.description: Base directory for rendered HTML reports, Feather files, and other artifacts. Any tool that receives a relative output path will write under this directory. Absolute paths are unaffected.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Server log verbosity (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

tools.name: load_candidates
tools.description: Load candidate/PSM tables from InstaNovo, Casanovo, MaxQuant, FragPipe, Proteome Discoverer, or generic mapped tables.

tools.name: render_psm_table
tools.description: Render a PSM table as HTML.

tools.name: render_peptide_table
tools.description: Render a peptide table as HTML.

tools.name: load_sdrf
tools.description: Load SDRF-Proteomics metadata from a local TSV.

tools.name: mzml_to_feather
tools.description: Convert an mzML file to Feather format.

tools.name: thermo_raw_to_mzml
tools.description: Convert a Thermo .raw file to mzML with ThermoRawFileParser, installed separately.

tools.name: thermo_raw_to_feather
tools.description: Convert a Thermo .raw file to Feather format through mzML from ThermoRawFileParser.

tools.name: mgf_to_feather
tools.description: Convert an MGF file to Feather format.

tools.name: bruker_d_to_feather
tools.description: Convert Bruker timsTOF data to Feather format.

tools.name: export_to_instanovo
tools.description: Export spectra in an InstaNovo-compatible format.

tools.name: describe_predictor_model
tools.description: Inspect model metadata before a remote Koina prediction.

tools.name: build_prediction_batch
tools.description: Build a batch of fragment predictions.

tools.name: inspect_prediction_batch_status
tools.description: Inspect the current status of a prediction batch.

tools.name: score_spectrum
tools.description: Score a single peptide against a spectrum.

tools.name: score_from_prediction_batch
tools.description: Score using a precomputed prediction batch.

tools.name: inspect_scored_batch_status
tools.description: Inspect the current status of a scored batch.

tools.name: annotate_observed_spectrum
tools.description: Annotate an observed spectrum with matched ions.

tools.name: render_observed_spectrum
tools.description: Render an observed spectrum as HTML.

tools.name: render_annotated_observed_spectrum
tools.description: Render an annotated observed spectrum as HTML.

tools.name: list_distribution_fields
tools.description: List fields available for distribution summaries.
